questiontext.text: What is the fundamental scientific distinction between the mass and the weight of a body?

questiontext.text: Which technique is commonly used by mechanical engineers to reduce unwanted friction between moving parts of an engine?

generalfeedback.text: Lubricants like oil and grease create a smooth fluid film between contacting surfaces, preventing direct metal-on-metal rubbing and reducing friction.

answer.text: Applying lubricating oil or grease between metal surfaces

feedback.text: Correct! Lubricants like oil and grease create a smooth fluid film between contacting surfaces, preventing direct metal-on-metal rubbing and reducing friction.

answer.text: Pouring dry sand and gravel inside the gearbox

feedback.text: Incorrect. Lubricants like oil and grease create a smooth fluid film between contacting surfaces, preventing direct metal-on-metal rubbing and reducing friction.

answer.text: Roughening the smooth metal surfaces with a steel file

feedback.text: Incorrect. Lubricants like oil and grease create a smooth fluid film between contacting surfaces, preventing direct metal-on-metal rubbing and reducing friction.

answer.text: Increasing the surface weight and pressing parts tighter

feedback.text: Incorrect. Lubricants like oil and grease create a smooth fluid film between contacting surfaces, preventing direct metal-on-metal rubbing and reducing friction.
